claim_text: The December 16, 2025 indictment in United States v. Sallah, No. 0:25-cr-00482 (ECF 1), alleges that between approximately March 2023 and August 2025 Kaamil Omar Sallah and SafeLodgings, Inc. fraudulently claimed to be entitled to approximately $1.4 million for Housing Stabilization Services and received nearly $1.3 million. Paragraph 23 restates the claimed-entitled figure as about $1.4 million for purported services to nearly 150 beneficiaries. The $1.4 million is amount_claimed and the $1.3 million is amount_paid; they are in the same paragraph and must not be added. These are charging allegations, not proven_loss. Do not add them to first-wave HSS (Aden/Falade/Anwar/Asad) or to Feeding Our Future.

supporting_passages.quote: In all, between approximately March 2023 and August 2025, SALLAH and his company fraudulently claimed to be entitled to approximately $1.4 million for providing Housing Stabilization Services and received nearly $1.3 million.
Ultimately, SALLAH fraudulently claimed to service nearly 150 different beneficiaries through SafeLodgings and for such services claimed to be entitled to about $1.4 million.

amounts.methodology: Indictment para 13: fraudulently claimed to be entitled to approximately $1.4 million. Restated para 23. Face of charging document.
Indictment para 13: received nearly $1.3 million. Amount_paid to the provider; schema has no amount_received. Same paragraph as $1.4M claimed; do not add.

qualifiers: do not sum para 13 + para 23 claimed figures
do not add to Aden $2.3M, Falade $2.2M, Anwar $1.2M, Asad $2.7M, or FOF $250M
para 1 'more than a million dollars' is qualitative and overlaps these figures
